chars.SAID: a Moroccan man about 30, neat short black hair, trimmed short beard, wearing a light grey crew-neck sweater, dark navy chinos and clean white sneakers
chars.MAID: a Moroccan woman about 55, round face, wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba, a dark green headscarf and a beige kitchen apron

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. In the small backyard of a modern villa near Casablanca, the MAID stands next to an empty wire chicken coop with its door open, holding a handful of white feathers, caught by surprise and looking toward the viewer with wide guilty eyes. Seen from the back doorway of the house, head-to-waist framing, her face clearly visible in the centre. White feathers scattered on the tiled floor. Calm plain wall background at the edges. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. SAID sits in the back seat of a small ride-hailing car stuck in Casablanca traffic in the afternoon, checking his watch impatiently, city buildings and palm trees blurred outside the window. Face clearly visible in the centre, head-to-waist. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. SAID has just stepped into the backyard of his villa holding his house keys, frozen in shock, staring at an empty wire chicken coop with its door open and white feathers scattered on the floor and stuck in the wire. Seen from slightly behind and to the side so his shocked face is visible. Subjects in the centre, calm background at the edges. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. In a bright clean kitchen, SAID stands in the doorway pointing back toward the backyard, asking a question with raised eyebrows, while the MAID by the sink answers calmly with an innocent shrug and open palms, a little too relaxed. Both faces visible, head-to-waist framing, both in the centre. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. In the kitchen, the MAID mimes with her hands a cat pouncing and chasing chickens, eyes wide, telling an exaggerated story, while SAID stands with arms crossed, one eyebrow raised, clearly not believing her. Both faces visible, head-to-waist, centre of the frame. A single white feather on the floor. No text.
